title: Measure the 60-second core compile budget on Linux under load and cut what measures as a real lever
goal: Measure cold and warm build, test, startup and change-to-useful-result times of Susi core separately on the CEO's Linux x86_64 laptop under real multi-agent load, identify the critical path and levers, land any lever that measures better without removing capability, and record the numbers.

provenance.host: CEO laptop, CachyOS Linux x86_64, 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13850HX, 28 logical CPUs, 219 GiB RAM
provenance.worktree: susi-agent-buildtime, branch local-agent/buildtime, own target directory
